entities.name: Duskmantle
entities.description: Guildhall of House Dimir on Ravnica, a hidden castle in the Undercity, later recreated by Lazav.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Ruler of House Dimir during the original Duskmantle; he died.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Recreated Duskmantle in a different part of the Undercity.

events.summary: After Szadek's demise the location and entry to Duskmantle were lost.
events.quote: After Szadek's demise, both the location and way of gaining entry were lost

events.summary: Lazav recreated Duskmantle elsewhere in the Undercity, shielded by memory wards.
events.quote: Lazav recreated the structure in a different part of the Undercity

relations.quote: It was a hidden castle located in the Undercity
